required_fixes.exact_new_text: Law 2466 of 2025 art. 21 converted the apprenticeship into a special fixed-term LABOUR contract, regulated by Decree 0223 of 5 March 2026. Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 4; PILA tipo cotizante 19 'Aprendices etapa lectiva Ley 2466 de 2025' for the lectiva phase from the health period of August 2025 (code 12 only for earlier periods). For health periods before August 2025, code 19 covers the productive phase; from the health period of August 2025, AT2 v30 names no code for the productive phase (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.1 campo 5, types 12 and 19).

Apprenticeship. Law 2466 of 2025 art. 21 recast this as a special fixed-term LABOUR contract, regulated by Decree 0223 of 5 March 2026. PILA tipo cotizante 19 'Aprendices etapa lectiva Ley 2466 de 2025' for the lectiva phase from the health period of August 2025 (code 12 only for earlier periods). For health periods before August 2025, code 19 covers the productive phase; from the health period of August 2025, AT2 v30 names no code for the productive phase (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.1 campo 5, types 12 and 19).
Apprentice, lectiva phase (electronic payroll table 5.5.3). In PILA, code 12 applies only to health periods before August 2025: health only, IBC 1 SMMLV (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.1 campo 5, type 12).

Apprentice, productive phase (electronic payroll table 5.5.3). In PILA, code 19 is 'Aprendices etapa lectiva Ley 2466 de 2025' from the health period of August 2025: health and occupational risk only, IBC 1 SMMLV; it covers the productive phase only for health periods before August 2025 (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.1 campo 5, type 19). The electronic payroll code and the PILA code are mapped separately.

PILA return types: E for a late payment, M only for periods before health period March 2014 (Country Fields W80, Country Option Mappers F221). Apprentice PILA codes under Ley 2466 de 2025 (Country Option Mappers F60, F65, F66).

Voluntary contributions to voluntary pension funds under ET art. 126-1 and DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.1.22.41. DISTINCT from numeral 25 (voluntary contributions to the RAIS, ET art. 55). Source: the voluntary-fund ('FVOL') wage types 25811-25815, 25823 and, for retirees, 21141, the same source as Form 220 casilla 56; the institutional-plan wage types (25820, 25821, 21210, 21211, 21212, 65803, 65804) are reported here only for the amount deducted from the employee's labour income in the employee's name, the rule of Form 220 casilla 56 (ET art. 126-1; DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.1.22.41); employer contributions to institutional plans are distinguished through the employer- / employee-side attribute of each institutional-plan wage type, which comes from the WTC. A combined voluntary-pension total is never used as the source. Maps to Form 220 casilla 56.
